connection_mode.title: Connection mode
connection_mode.description:
Choose which connections this integration may use.

**Bluetooth only** is fully local: Home Assistant never contacts the F-LINX cloud. There is no MQTT push and the periodic cloud poll is switched off, so the door's position is only updated by commands Home Assistant sends itself. If the door is opened another way — an RF remote, the wall button, the F-LINX app or the auto-close timer — Home Assistant will not see it and the state stays stale until it next sends a command. The position is also unknown after a restart until the first command.

**Bluetooth preferred** sends commands locally when the opener is in range and falls back to the cloud otherwise. State comes from MQTT push, so door movements from a remote are picked up.

**Cloud preferred** does the same in reverse: the cloud first, Bluetooth as the fallback when the door is off WiFi.

**Cloud only** switches the Bluetooth stack off entirely, freeing your adapter's or proxy's connection slot. Commands take the cloud's round trip, and without the local position stream setting a partial position is less precise.

poll_interval.title: Periodic cloud poll
poll_interval.description: MQTT push is the primary state source. Optionally poll the cloud API on a fixed schedule to recover state that MQTT silently drops (e.g. when the door is operated by a physical remote).

devices.title: Manage devices
devices.description: Select which doors on this account to configure. Unchecking a door removes its device and entities from Home Assistant.

refresh_state.name: Refresh state
refresh_state.description: Force an immediate state read from the F-LINX cloud API, bypassing MQTT. Useful in automations when MQTT push updates are unreliable.
